findings.title: Non-refundable Wire Transfer Registration Fee
findings.fact: Vendor must submit a non-refundable Wire Transfer Registration Fee of $5,000 USD to an offshore holding account to validate corporate account and receive full RFP package.
findings.business_implication: This is a significant upfront cost with no guarantee of contract award, and the offshore account raises concerns about legitimacy.
findings.action_recommendation: Verify the legitimacy of the RFP and the recipient account; consider this a red flag for potential fraud.

findings.title: IP Assignment to Buyer
findings.fact: All intellectual property developed prior to and during the contract will become the sole property of Global Procurement Solutions Inc.
findings.business_implication: The bidder would lose rights to any pre-existing IP and any new IP developed, which is highly unusual and potentially detrimental.
findings.action_recommendation: Seek legal advice and attempt to negotiate IP terms before bidding.
